proposal.summary: A bug in NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit's cuobjdump allows a local user to cause a null-pointer dereference by running the tool against an ill-formed binary, potentially causing a limited denial of service.
proposal.affected_product: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit SDK (cuobjdump) — versions not specified
proposal.cwe_quote: a local user running the tool against an ill-formed binary may cause a null- pointer dereference

AV.quote: a local user running the tool against an ill-formed binary

PR.quote: a local user running the tool against an ill-formed binary

A.quote: may result in a limited denial of service

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or confirm vendor advisory or patch details, reproduce crash locally with a crafted ill-formed binary to collect crash artifacts and determine affected versions and exact impact, and obtain a fixed cuobjdump binary or patch from NVIDIA.

evidence_quotes.claim: Null-pointer dereference caused by running tool on ill-formed binary
evidence_quotes.quote: a local user running the tool against an ill-formed binary may cause a null- pointer dereference
which may result in a limited denial of service
